payload.name: ExtractExplicitFutureGoalsAndAspirations
payload.description: When a message contains an explicit statement about what the speaker wants to do or achieve in the future, extract it as a memory candidate during extraction.
content: During extraction, treat explicit future intentions, goals, or aspirations stated by the speaker as extractable memories, even when they describe long-term or post-career plans; do not skip such messages merely because they are reflective.
Represent each stated aspiration as a plan or state candidate tied to the speaker, recording the desired outcome and any optional actions, and link it to the source message.

solves: The diagnosed failure was that a clear statement of future intentions was ingested but no memory candidate was extracted, causing silent data loss. The reusable mechanism is omission of explicit future goals or aspirations during extraction. A skill that forces extraction of stated plans and desired outcomes transfers across any future-oriented intention statements, preventing the same ingestion-stage loss.
